The '''BTL-A4 LP''', nicknamed the '''Longprobe''', was a variant of the standard [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]] used as a reconnaissance and [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:YWingLongprobe-SWR.png|thumb|left|180px|A "Longprobe" in flight]]
The ship was designed so it could better implement the longer-duration missions of the profile of the BTL Y-wing starfighter, such as scouting. As such, the second pilot for the [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|S3 variant]], as well as all on-board life and mission support equipment, were removed to allow for this. Because of the consequentially lighter frame, the ship could handle heavier payloads as a substitute for better avionics equipment or weapons-fit out and payloads. In addition, although the turret at the cockpit was retained, it has been changed to save on lightness and locked in the forward firing position.
